name: Vanguard International Semiconductor Corporation
summary: Vanguard International Semiconductor Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in manufacturing, selling, packaging, testing, and computer-aided design of integrated circuits and other semiconductor devices in Taiwan and internationally. The company offers various foundry process technologies, including high voltage, ultra-high voltage, bipolar CMOS DMOS, silicon on insulator, discrete, sensors, micro electro mechanical system, and embedded flash, as well as manufactures and sells masks. It also offers multiple project wafer services; mask services comprising frame generation, mask making, tape out/itapeout, and mask repairing; backend services, including front-side metallization,…
